title: Restore local audio playback from cluster passages
description:
As a curator reviewing a cluster draft on the LAN, I want each representative passage to play so that I can complete an evidence-based listening review.

Feature: local cluster passage playback

Scenario: opening the WebAssembly module from the standalone local server
Given Apricity is served by the standalone local server
When a curator starts playback from a cluster representative card
Then GET /apricity_web.wasm returns the WebAssembly module with a successful response
And the audio engine starts and auditions the requested passage

Scope: restore the standalone server route and local build/serve artifact only. No changes to clustering membership, publication, or review approval.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause confirmed: the standalone preview bundle omitted apricity_web.wasm, so the browser received a 404 during WebAssembly.compileStreaming. Installed the existing local 3.4 MB module into the preview web root. Verified GET /apricity_web.wasm returns 200 with application/wasm and compiled the returned bytes successfully with WebAssembly.compile.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Eliminated the review-page stall: preview now validates only the current native rows and analyses referenced by the draft’s representative passages, rather than rebuilding the full library catalog. Verification: 11 targeted Python tests pass; the real local preview endpoint returned 591 clusters in 17.47 seconds; a fresh LAN browser tab completed the draft rendering.

right_now_summary: The local preview now serves the WebAssembly module and loads cluster passages for playback.
